kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public update-baseline --baseline-id 1000010800007 --project-id 2043 --baseline-name BaselineName --owner 37263460000 --priority 7 --node-ids 1,2,3 --overtime-settings Time=00:00 Cycle=1 --alert-margin-threshold 30 --baseline-type DAILY --enabled true --alert-enabled true --alert-settings '[{"AlertInterval":30,"AlertMaximum":1,"AlertRecipient":"123123","AlertRecipientType":"OWNER","AlertMethods":["SMS"],"DingRobots":[{"AtAll":false,"WebUrl":"https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send0access_token=xxx"}],"AlertType":"BASELINE","TopicTypes":["SLOW"],"TopicSlowConfig":{"MinOver":3600,"OverFactor":0.2},"Webhooks":["https://open.feishu.cn/open-apis/bot/v2/hook/xxx"],"SilenceEndTime":"00:00","SilenceStartTime":"00:00","BaselineAlertEnabled":true}]' --remove-node-ids 123,456 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateBaseline

parameters.help_en: The ID of the baseline. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261507.html to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 基线的ID, 可通过 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261507.html 获取
parameters.name: baseline_id

parameters.help_en: The project ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261507.html to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 项目ID, 可通过 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261507.html 获取
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the baseline owner
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en: The priority of the baseline. Valid values: 1, 3, 5, 7, and 8
parameters.help_zh: 基线的优先级，取值范围为{1,3,5,7,8}
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The list of upstream node IDs for the baseline, separated by commas. If there are many nodes, we recommend that you add a virtual node downstream for easier management
parameters.help_zh: 基线上游节点列表，使用逗号分割，节点较多的情况下，建议在其下游增加虚节点，便于管理
parameters.name: node_ids

fields.help_en: The epoch corresponding to the committed time. For daily baselines, the value is 1. For hourly baselines, you can configure up to 24 epochs
fields.help_zh: 承诺时间对应的周期，天基线是1，小时基线可以配置最多24个周期
fields.name: cycle

fields.help_en: The committed time in hh:mm format. Valid values of hh: 0 to 47. Valid values of mm: 0 to 59
fields.help_zh: 承诺时间，hh:mm格式，hh的取值范围为[0,47]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]
fields.name: time

parameters.help_en: The baseline alert margin. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 基线预警余量，单位为分钟
parameters.name: alert_margin_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The baseline type. Valid values:
DAILY: daily baseline.
HOURLY: hourly baseline
parameters.help_zh: 基线类型，包括DAILY（天基线）和HOURLY（小时基线）
parameters.name: baseline_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the baseline is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh: 基线是否开启，包括true（可用）和false（不可用）
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether alerting is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启告警，包括true（开启）和false（关闭）
parameters.name: alert_enabled

fields.help_en: The event alerting interval. Unit: minutes. Minimum value: 5. Maximum value: 1440
fields.help_zh: 事件告警间隔，单位为分钟，最小为5，最大值为 1440
fields.name: alert_interval

fields.help_en: The maximum number of event alerting notifications. Maximum value: 288
fields.help_zh: 事件告警最大次数，最大为288
fields.name: alert_maximum

fields.help_en:
Valid values:
MAIL: email.
SMS: text message.
PHONE: phone call. Only DataWorks Professional Edition and higher support phone call alerts.
DINGROBOTS: DingTalk chatbot. This alert method takes effect only after the RobotUrls parameter is configured.
Webhooks: WeCom or Lark chatbot. This alert method takes effect only after the Webhooks parameter is configured
fields.help_zh:
MAIL（邮件）
SMS（短信）
PHONE（电话），仅DataWorks专业版及以上版本支持使用电话方式接收报警。
DINGROBOTS（钉钉机器人），仅当配置RobotUrls参数后，该报警方式才会生效。
Webhooks（企业微信或飞书机器人），仅当配置 Webhooks 参数后，该报警方式才会生效
fields.name: alert_methods

fields.help_en: The alert recipient details. For specified users: a list of employee IDs. For on-duty schedule: the schedule name. For owner: leave empty
fields.help_zh: 告警接收人详情，指定人：工号列表，值班表：值班表名，责任人：空
fields.name: alert_recipient

fields.help_en:
The alert recipient type. Valid values:
OWNER: node owner.
OTHER: specified users.
SHIFT_SCHEDULE: on-duty schedule
fields.help_zh: 告警接收人类型，OWNER（任务责任人）/ OTHER（指定的人）/ SHIFT_SCHEDULE（值班表）
fields.name: alert_recipient_type

fields.help_en:
The alert type. Valid values:
BASELINE: baseline alerting.
TOPIC: event alerting
fields.help_zh: 告警类型，BASELINE - 基线 / TOPIC - 事件
fields.name: alert_type

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether baseline alerting is enabled. This is a baseline-specific configuration. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
fields.help_zh: 基线告警开关，基线特有配置，包括true（是）和false（否）
fields.name: baseline_alert_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to @all members. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
fields.help_zh: 是否@所有人，包括true（是）和false（否）
fields.name: at_all

fields.help_en: The webhook URL of the DingTalk group chatbot
fields.name: web_url

fields.help_en: The minimum slowdown threshold. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 300 to 18000
fields.help_zh: 最小变慢阈值，单位为秒，取值范围为 300～18000
fields.name: min_over

fields.help_en: The ratio used to calculate the slowdown threshold based on the historical average execution duration of the node. Valid values: 0.1 to 2
fields.help_zh: 基于任务历史平均运行耗时计算变慢阈值的比例，取值范围为 0.1～2
fields.name: over_factor

fields.help_en: The threshold configuration for event slowdown alerts
fields.help_zh: 事件变慢告警的阈值配置
fields.name: topic_slow_config

fields.help_en: The event alerting type. This is an event-specific configuration
fields.help_zh: 事件告警类型，事件特有配置
fields.name: topic_types

parameters.help_en: The IDs of nodes to remove from the baseline. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要从基线上提出的节点ID，多个ID间使用,分隔
parameters.name: remove_node_ids

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the baseline is updated

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
